company.name: Blend
company.shortDescription: Blend unifies food delivery apps, POS, and menus into one dashboard—built for restaurants, cafés, and stores to simplify operations.
company.description:
Blend is a Saudi-based SaaS platform transforming how restaurants, cafés, and retail stores manage their delivery operations. By integrating all major food delivery apps, POS systems, and in-store channels into one centralized dashboard, Blend empowers businesses to simplify order management, synchronize menus in real-time, and monitor performance insights across platforms — all in one place.

From automated order routing to unified analytics, Blend helps F&B operators boost efficiency, reduce human error, and deliver better customer experiences. Built for the fast-moving MENA market, Blend is the backend engine powering smarter, seamless, and scalable food delivery operations.

productsAndServices.description: A platform that consolidates and automates order management from multiple food delivery apps into a single dashboard for restaurants, cafés, and stores.
productsAndServices.name: Blend Delivery Management Platform
